entry.title: Awesome Animal Care Updates on Jul 06, 2026
entry.content:
Hamsters / Hamster Books

  • Hamster Care Guide - British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (BCSPCA) - Practical handbook focusing on step-by-step beginner socialization and safe handling techniques.
  • How to Care for Syrian Hamsters - Ginger Clarke - Comprehensive and in-depth guide on how to care for Syrian hamsters.

Hamsters / Hamster Care & Treatment

  • Hamster Care Sheet - Pet Advocacy Network - Quick reference about basic care for hamsters.
  • Hamsters (Advice & Welfare) - Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) - Comprehensive, expert-vetted guidance from the RSPCA on hamster care.

Hamster Behaviour & Training / Hamster Care & Treatment

  • Understanding Hamster Behaviour - Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) - Handy checklist for a happy & healthy hamster.
  • Hamsters Behaviour & Taming - Rachel Got Hamsters - Tried & tested tips from a hamster caretaker.

Hamster Behaviour & Training / Hamster Diet & Nutrition

  • Hamster Nutritional Requriements - The Hamingway - Comprehensive, detailed guide about macro & micro nutrient diet requirements for hamsters.
  • What Can Hamsters Eat - PetMD - Quick list of food items that hamsters can & cannot eat.
  • Hamster Diet - Elmbrook Humane Society (EBHS) - Practical guide for hamster diet.

entry.title: Awesome Animal Care Updates on May 18, 2026
entry.content:
Common Resources for all animals / Welfare Organizations

  • Rabbit.org - Since 1995, Rabbit.org has been the home of the most trusted rabbit information on the internet. They are dedicated to ending the suffering, abuse, and exploitation of all rabbits.
  • Rabbit Welfare Association & Fund (RWAF) - They are UK’s largest organisation for rabbit welfare involved in owner education, campaigning for stronger legislation, and certifying rabbit-friendly veterinary practices.

Rabbits / Rabbit Books

  • House Rabbit Handbook: How to Live With an Urban Rabbit - Marinell Harriman - A seminal guide that revolutionized indoor rabbit care by introducing the concept of free-roam, litter-trained companion rabbits.
  • On the Hop (Version 6), The RWAF Guide to rabbit care - Rabbit Welfare Association & Fund (RWAF) - Beginner-friendly rabbit care guide by RWAF covers topics like rabbit diet, neutering, preventative health care, grooming, coat care, choosing a vet and managing aggressive behaviour in rabbits.

Rabbits / Rabbit Care & Treatment

  • Bunny Care 101 - Pet Health Network - General tips on rabbit care.
  • Care Basics - Rabbit.org - Includes diet, grooming, housing, play and littertraining articles for rabbit care.
  • Caring For The Elderly Or Senior Rabbit - Lafeber - Discusses signs of an aging rabbit and tips on how to care for them.
  • Identifying Rabbit Pain - The Educated Rabbit - Talks about the signs of a sick rabbit along with measuring pain with Grimace Scales as a further reading.
  • MediRabbit - The Ultimate Rabbit Medicine Resource on the Net - Comprehensive educational website on rabbit medicine.
  • Rabbit Care - My House Rabbit - Rabbit care basics (from diet to housing to bunny proofing) in order to create a safe, loving environment.

Rabbits / Rabbit Behaviour & Training

  • How to start training your rabbit - The Bunbrary Blog - Beginner's guide to start rabbit training with a clicker.
  • What Rabbit Training Really Is (And Why It Matters) - Badass Bunny Rescuer - Explains intricacies of rabbit training, includes building trust, giving your rabbit agency and low stress target training.

Rabbits / Rabbit Diet & Nutrition

  • Ideal Rabbit Diet - The Rabbit Doctors - Ideal rabbit diet based on BSAVA recommendations.
  • Rabbit Diet - House Rabbit Resource Network - Articles on what rabbits eat, importance of hay, pellets, fresh foods and treat recipes.
  • Rabbit Food Pyramid - San Diego House Rabbit Society - Healthy rabbit diet explained in detail with a food pyramid infographic.

entry.title: Awesome Animal Care Updates on Apr 02, 2026
entry.content:
Common Resources for all animals / Books

  • Animal Behavior for Shelter Veterinarians and Staff - Emily Weiss, Heather Mohan-Gibbons, Stephen Zawistowski - Presents and evaluates the available research and programs that address both animal and human behaviors associated with the intake, management and rehoming of dog and cats.
  • Animal Care and Use Handbook - Virginia State University - Comprehensive guidelines for the ethical treatment, housing and management of laboratory animals at Virginia State University.
  • Guidelines for the design and management of animal shelters - International Companion Animal Coalition - Handbook containing guidelines for the design and management of animal shelters.
  • The Guidelines for Standards of Care in Animal Shelters - Association of Shelter Veterinarians - Evidence-based, consensus-driven standards and guidance for improving companion animal shelter care, welfare, design and policy.
  • Pet Care Basics - Premier VetCare - Practical home wellness guide covering essential pet care topics like vaccinations, parasite prevention, dental health, disease prevention and emergency care.
  • Rescue Group Best Practices Guide - Humane World for Animals - Provide general information about animal rescue best practices.
  • The Best Practice Playbook for Animal Shelters - Sara Pizano, Kate Hurley - Concise playbook of proven strategies for animal shelters to reduce intake, improve outcomes, engage communities and build compassionate, data-driven animal welfare systems.
  • Wildlife Rescue Handbook: The First 24 Hours - Wildlife Heroes - First-response guide to safely rescuing, handling and providing essential first aid to injured wildlife before transferring them to professional care.
  • Zoobiquity: The Astonishing Connection Between Human and Animal Health - Barbara Natterson-Horowitz, Kathryn Bowers - Thought-provoking exploration of the deep connections between human and animal health, showing how a cross-species, collaborative approach to medicine can improve understanding, diagnosis and treatment for all.

Common Resources for all animals / Care & Treatment

  • Choosing & Knowing Your Veterinarian - American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) - Guide about choosing a good vet and co-ordinating with them to ensure the best treatment for your animal.
  • Emergency Care - American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) - Immediate first aid and emergency care, strictly as a bridge until your animal can be seen by a veterinarian.
  • Resources for pet owners - American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) - Collection of resources for pet owners on proper pet care, first aid and pet health concerns.
  • Stray Animal Care - FOUR PAWS International - Collection of stray animal care resources including topics like Catch-Neuter-Vaccinate-Return (CNVR), community engagement, monitoring, evaluation & impact, responsible pet ownership, shelter adoption programme and animal assisted interventions.

Common Resources for all animals / Diet & Nutrition

  • Creating a Nutrition Plan - Pet Nutrition Alliance - Includes establishing nutrient goals, providing a complete and balanced diet for patients, selecting an appropriate food and determining how much to feed.

Common Resources for all animals / News

  • National Geographic - Some of nature's most incredible species through recent discoveries and groundbreaking studies on animal habitats, behaviors and unique adaptations.

Common Resources for all animals / RSS Feeds

  • Animal Health Smartbrief - American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) - RSS feed link for AVMA's daily newsletter providing news of importance to animal health professionals. This includes: veterinary medicine updates, animal welfare and pet product news, best business practices and regulatory updates.

Common Resources for all animals / Welfare Organizations

  • American Bird Conservancy (ABC) - Conserves birds and their habitats through policy advocacy and direct action.
  • American Heartworm Society (AHS) - Leads the veterinary profession in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of heartworm disease.
  • American Kennel Club (AKC) - Dog registry that promotes responsible dog ownership and maintains breed standards.
  • American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - One of the largest animal rights groups in the world, focused on awareness, rescue, protection and placement.
  • American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) - Not-for-profit organization that represents over 108,000 members, aiming to advance the veterinary profession while protecting animal and human health.
  • Animal Rescue Konnection (ARK) - Provides resources and support to help shelters and rescues save "at-risk" dogs through awareness and training.
  • Association of Shelter Veterinarians - Advances the practice of shelter medicine to improve the health and well-being of animals in rehoming centers.
  • BirdLife International - World's largest nature conservation partnership, uniting 124 national NGOs to protect birds and global biodiversity.
  • Blue Cross of India - One of India's oldest animal welfare charities, recognized for pioneering humane stray population management and wildlife rehabilitation.
  • Brooke India - Branch of Brooke that works directly with equine owners in India to improve the health and working conditions of donkeys and horses.
  • Brooke International - Global charity focused on the welfare of working equines, helping to sustain the livelihoods of people in developing countries.
  • Cats Protection UK - UK's leading cat welfare charity, focusing on rehoming stray cats, neutering campaigns and education.
  • Dog's Trust - Largest dog welfare charity in the UK, famous for its "A dog is for life" slogan and its commitment to never euthanising a healthy dog.
  • Eurogroup for Animals- Brussels-based federation that lobbies the EU for stronger animal protection laws and better enforcement across member states.
  • FOUR PAWS International - Rescues animals in distress (such as bears from private keepings or strays in disaster zones) and runs sanctuaries worldwide.
  • German Animal Welfare Foundation (Deutscher Tierschutzbund) - Europe's largest animal welfare umbrella organization, representing over 800 local animal protection societies in Germany.
  • Humane Fort Wayne - Indiana-based organization providing low-cost spay/neuter services, wellness clinics and pet adoptions.
  • Humane World for Animals - Promotes animal rights through international campaigns against animal testing, factory farming and wildlife exploitation.
  • International Bird Rescue - Leader in the rehabilitation of aquatic birds, specifically known for its expert response to man-made environmental disasters like oil spills.
  • International Companion Animal Coalition - Coalition of global NGOs that creates standard frameworks for humane dog and cat population management.
  • International Cat Care - Works to create a world where all cats are treated with care, compassion and an understanding of their unique needs.
  • People for the Ethical Treatement of Animals (PETA) - International organization known for high-impact campaigns against the use of animals for food, clothing, research and entertainment.
  • People For Animals India (PFA India) - India's largest animal welfare organization, founded by Maneka Gandhi, which runs a network of shelters and hospitals.
  • Pet Nutrition Alliance (PNA) - Collaboration of veterinary organizations that provides objective nutritional tools for pet owners and veterinary teams.
  • Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) - Founded in 1824, it is the world's oldest animal welfare charity, focused on investigating animal cruelty and rescuing animals in need.
  • Royal Society for Protection of Birds (RSPB)- UK's largest nature conservation charity, managing over 200 nature reserves to protect birds and their environments.
  • Save The Snakes - International conservation organization that protects snake populations and mitigates human-snake conflict through education.
  • The People's Dispensary for Sick Animals (PDSA) - Provides free and low-cost veterinary treatment to the pets of people in financial need across the UK.
  • The Gabriel Foundation (TGF) - Parrot welfare organization providing sanctuary, rehabilitation and adoption for companion parrots.
  • World Animal Protection (WAP now, formerly WSPA) - International non-profit working to move governments and corporations to protect animals in farming, the wild and disaster zones.
  • World Animal Protection India - Indian office of WAP, advocating for animal-friendly policies in Indian livestock management and wildlife protection.
  • World Horse Welfare - Focuses on the prevention of abuse and suffering of horses through education, campaigning and hands-on rehabilitation.
  • World Parrot Trust - Works globally to protect wild parrots from the illegal pet trade and to improve the care of parrots in captivity.

Common Resources for all animals / Food Hazards & Poison Control

  • People Foods to Avoid Feeding Your Pets - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA)
  • Poisonous Household Products - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA)
  • Poisonous Plants - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA)
  • Top 10 Deadliest Pet Poisons - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA)

Cats / Cat Books

  • Bark!, The Official BCSPCA Guide Cat Care Guide - British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (BCSPCA) - Comprehensive, practical guide to responsible cat ownership covering health, behavior, nutrition and everyday care essentials.
  • Cat Owner's Guide - Humane Fort Wayne - Hands-on adoption and care manual addressing common cat health, behavior, training and household integration challenges.
  • Essential Guides - Cats Protection - Set of 17 essential PDF guides offering expert advice on all aspects of cat care, behavior and welfare.
  • Think Like a Cat: How to Raise a Well-Adjusted Cat, Not a Sour Puss - Miriam M. Gonzalez Hernandez - Behavior-focused guide that helps owners understand feline instincts and communication to build a he
  • Total Cat Mojo: The Ultimate Guide to Life with Your Cat - Jackson Galaxy - Guide to understanding cat psychology and creating an enriching environment that promotes confidence, wellbeing and strong human-cat bonds.

Cats / Cat Care & Treatment

  • Cats.com - In-depth cat product reviews to veterinarian-written guides on cat health issues, medications and more.
  • Catster - Information about cat health, behaviour and products. A popular cat blog called "Conscious Cat" is now part of Catster.
  • Common Cat Diseases - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Information about diseases and other medical inflictions that frequently impact cats.

Dogs / Dog Books

  • Adopter's Guide to Rescue Dogs, What to do and expect in the first few months - Ruth Hegarty, M.S.E., Dog Trainer in association with Animal Rescue Konnection (ARK) - Practical roadmap for new adopters on helping rescue dogs adjust, build trust and thrive during the critical first months.
  • After You Get Your Puppy - Dr. Ian Dunbar, Dog Star Daily Blog - Step-by-step guide to raising a well-behaved puppy through early training, socialization and habit-building from day one.
  • Bark!, The Official BCSPCA Dog Care Guide - British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (BCSPCA) - Comprehensive guide to responsible dog ownership covering health, behavior, training and daily care essentials.
  • Before and After Getting Your Puppy: The Positive Approach to Raising a Happy, Healthy and Well-Behaved Dog - Dr. Ian Dunbar with Michael Page - Complete, positive-training manual covering everything from choosing a puppy to raising a well-mannered, socially confident dog.
  • Before You Get Your Puppy - Dr. Ian Dunbar, Dog Star Daily Blog - Preparatory guide to choosing the right puppy and setting up a strong foundation for successful training and lifelong wellbeing.
  • Dog Owner's Guide - Humane Fort Wayne - Comprehensive handbook for dog owners covering health care, behavior management, training basics and home integration.
  • Feeling Outnumbered?: How to Manage and Enjoy Your Multi-Dog Household - Karen B. London, Patricia B. McConnell - Behaviour-focused guide to managing multi-dog households and fostering harmony between dogs.
  • I'll be Home Soon: How to Prevent and Treat Separation Anxiety. - Patricia B. McConnell - Concise guide to understanding, preventing and treating separation anxiety in dogs.
  • Rescuing Rover: A First Aid and Disaster Guide for Dog Owners - Sebastian E. Heath, Purdue University - First aid and disaster preparedness guide to help dog owners respond effectively in emergencies.
  • The Healthy Dog, An Intro to How to Keep Your Dog Healthy - American Kennel Club - Introductory guide to maintaining canine health through nutrition, preventive care and routine wellness practices.
  • The Forever Dog: Surprising New Science to Help Your Canine Companion Live Younger, Healthier and Longer - Rodney Habib, Karen Shaw Becker - Science-backed exploration of nutrition, lifestyle and environmental factors to help dogs live longer, healthier lives.
  • Wag: The Science of Making Your Dog Happy - Zazie Todd - Evidence-based guide to improving dog wellbeing through positive training, enrichment and understanding canine behavior.

Dogs / Dog Care & Treatment

  • Common Dog Diseases - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Information about diseases and other medical inflictions that frequently impact dogs.

Fishes / Fish Books

  • Encyclopedia Of Aquarium & Pond Fish - Illustrated reference covering hundreds of fish species alongside practical guidance on selection, care, compatibility, and aquarium or pond setup.
  • Freshwater Aquarium Handbook - Elmer's Aquarium - Beginner-friendly manual covering aquarium setup, maintenance, water quality, and essential fish care practices for freshwater tanks.
  • Sunken Gardens: A Step-by-Step Guide to Planting Freshwater Aquariums - Karen Randall - Comprehensive guide to designing, planting, and maintaining beautiful aquascapes, combining aquatic plant science with practical aquarium care.
  • Tropical Fish, A Beginner's Guide - William Berg, AC Tropical Fish - Introductory guide to keeping tropical fish, focusing on tank setup, species selection, and basic care for new aquarists.

Horses / Horse Books

  • Complete Guide to Horse Care - The Humane Society of the United States - Comprehensive, practical guide to responsible horse ownership covering nutrition, health, behavior, housing, and lifelong welfare needs.
  • How to Think Like A Horse: The Essential Handbook for Understanding Why Horses Do What They Do - Cherry Hill - Behaviour-focused guide to understanding how horses perceive the world, helping owners communicate effectively and build trust through insight into equine instincts and psychology.

Horses / Horse Behaviour & Training

  • Bright Horse (Horse Behaviour) blog - Barbara J. Hardman - Insights, practical tips and real-life success stories about horse behaviour and training, ranging from managing anxiety to improving obedience.

Parrots / Parrot Books

  • Good Parrotkeeping: A Comprehensive Guide to All Things Parrot - Robin Deutsch - Comprehensive guide to responsible parrot care, covering behavior, nutrition, health, and creating a suitable home environment.
  • How to have a HAPPY HEALTHY PARROT - World Parrot Trust - Concise, welfare-focused guide to proper parrot care, emphasizing diet, enrichment, and physical and psychological wellbeing.
  • Happy Healthy Parrot Guide, A Reference for Beginners - World Parrot Trust - Beginner-friendly handbook introducing essential parrot care practices, including housing, nutrition, behavior, and welfare needs.
  • Parrot Parenting: The Essential Care and Training Guide to +20 Parrot Species - Carol Frischmann - Practical guide to caring for and training multiple parrot species, with a focus on behavior, bonding, and daily care routines.
  • Parrot Training: A Guide to Taming and Gentling Your Avian Companion - Step-by-step introduction to building trust and training parrots using gentle, behavior-based techniques.
  • The A to Z eBook on Parrot Care - Nathalie Roberts - Broad reference guide covering key aspects of parrot care, from basic needs to behavior and long-term wellbeing.
  • The Bird Owner's Manual - Emily Strong - Practical, accessible guide to companion bird care, focusing on behavior, training, enrichment, and welfare.
  • The Parrot Enrichment Activity Book, Version 2.0 - Kris Porter - Hands-on resource of enrichment ideas and activities designed to improve parrots’ mental stimulation and quality of life.

Parrots / Parrot Care & Treatment

  • Beyond Bird Basics (BBB) - The Gabriel Foundation (TGF) - Series of educational presentations and quizzes, free to the public. Covers health and anatomy, enrichment, food and nutrition and behaviour and training.
  • Bird Health & Anatomy Part 1 of 2 - The Gabriel Foundation (TGF) - Covers topics like bird poop, bathing your bird, laying eggs, bird dust and dangar, feather plucking and sleep time.
  • Bird Health & Anatomy Part 2 of 2 - The Gabriel Foundation (TGF) - Covers topics like bird respiratory system, boogers, nosebleeds, food digestion, regurgitation and vomiting, beak health and some common illnesses in birds.
  • Parrot Enrichment - The Gabriel Foundation (TGF) - Covers various types of bird enrichment activities.

entry.title: Awesome Animal Care Updates on Mar 18, 2026
entry.content:
Common Resources for all animals / Care & Treatment

  • Symptom Checker for Cats and Dogs - PetMD - Useful tool by Chewy’s vet team to quickly find out what might be going on and what to do next. Intended only for non-emergency animal health queries.
  • Symptom Checker for Cats and Dogs - Sydney Animal Hospitals - Symptom checker to guide on next steps of treatment. Intended only for non-emergency animal health queries.

Dogs / Dog Care & Treatment

Fishes / Fish Care & Treatment

  • What is the best fish food for my fish? - Aquatic Veterinary Services - Talks about pellets vs. flakes, the 6 Month Rule and how to choose food for your fish based on nutritional labels on food's packaging.

  • Basic Horse Care Guide for Beginners - Daily Checklist - Covers most aspects of horse care from diet and veterinary care, to shelter access daily oversight. Also has an option to download the content as a free PDF.

entry.title: Awesome Animal Care Updates on Jan 20, 2026
entry.content:
Common Resources for all animals / Care & Treatment

  • General Pet Care - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Health and behaviour information to help pet parents provide the best possible care for their furry friends.
  • Management of Specific Wounds in Small Animals - MSD (Merck) Vet Manual - Useful information to treat wounds in small animals like cats, dogs, rabbits, mice, ferrets, etc.
  • Pet Health Checker - British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (BCSPCA) - Symtom checker for dogs and cats.
  • Resource Center - American Heartworm Society (AHS) - Comprehensive resource center for Heartworm-related information (diagnosis, treatment & care).
  • Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines for Livestock and Poultry - DAHD India - Treatment guidebook for diseases in cattle, sheep, goats, camels and other animals.
  • The Problem of Self-Medication in Pets - SAVA Healthcare - Article explains why self-medication your pet is a problem and what you should do instead.

Common Resources for all animals / News

  • Daily Paws - Solid info on the everyday stuff (health issues, behavior, questions, challenges) for pet parents.
  • The Dodo - News for Animal People.
  • World Animal News - Covers news on everything from wild and domestic animals to threatened and endangered species.

Common Resources for all animals / RSS Feeds

  • The Dog Pod - Rebecca Tompkins - RSS feed link for The Dog Pod podcast which publishes curated, canine-related content.

Common Resources for all animals / Veterinary Reference

  • MSD (Merck) Veterinary Manual - One of the most widely used non-commercial medical resources for professionals and pet owners.
  • Veterinary Partner by VIN - Pet care information by veterinarians for pet owners, provided by Veterinary Information Network (VIN).

Common Resources for all animals / Food Hazards & Poison Control

  • Food Hazards - MSD (Merck) Vet Manual - Most common foods that can cause illness in animals.
  • Pet Poison Helpline - Searchable list of common substances, poisonous to animals.
  • Poison Control - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Valuable information to help owners recognize and protect their pets from poisonous substances including plants, human foods, human medications, etc.
  • Toxicoses From Household Cleaners and Personal Care Products in Animals - MSD (Merck) Vet Manual
  • US FDA - Potentially Dangerous Items for Your Pet - Guide to edible and non-edible substances potentially dangerous to animals.

Cats / Cat Care & Treatment

  • Cat Advice - International Cat Care - Searchable collection of in-depth cat advice articles on a huge range of feline health and wellbeing topics.
  • Cat Care - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Tips, solutions and answers to some of your most frequently asked feline questions.
  • Cat Health Center - FETCH by WebMD - Collection of information resources related to cat health.

Cats / Cat Behaviour & Training

  • How to Train a Cat: The Ultimate Cat Training Guide - CatSchool - Detailed article covering topics like obedience skills, problem behaviours, tricks and general cat training tips and FAQs.
  • Patience for Cats blog - Patience Fisher - Cat behaviour and training blog by Patience Fisher, a certified cat behaviour consultant.

Cats / Cat Diet & Nutrition

  • Feeding Kittens 101 - Hannah Hart, DVM on PetMD - Article covers when, what, how much and how often to feed kittens and transitioning them to adult cat food.
  • Feeding Your Cat - Cornell Feline Health Center - Things to consider when selecting an appropriate diet for your cat.
  • Feeding Your Cat: Know the Basics of Feline Nutrition - Lisa A. Pierson, DVM, CatInfo.org - Website covers the Basics of Feline Nutrition. Shortened version of website available here.
  • Is Grain-Free Cat Food Better? - Matthew Everett Miller, DVM on PetMD - Article about things you need to know about grain-free cat food.
  • Nutrition for Your Cat - Jaqueline Brister, DVM, Veterinary Partner by VIN - Article discussing cat nutrition constituents like proteins & carbohydrates, water intake, raw diets and medical management through food.
  • Proper Nutrition for Cats - MSD (Merck) Vet Manual - Discusses what, when, where and how much to feed your kitten or cat, feline nutrition standards and the need for a water bowl.

Dogs / Dog Care & Treatment

  • Calculate Your Dog's Age: How Old Is Your Dog? - Alyson Powell Key, Annie Stuart on WebMD FETCH - Provides a dog age chart to calculate your dog's age the right way.
  • Canine Heartworm Guidelines - American Heartworm Society - Includes guidelines for prevention, diagnosis and management of heartworm infections.
  • Checklist for Puppy Proofing Your Home - Cathy Madson on Preventive Vet - Provides a simple checklist of things to do when getting your new puppy or dog home.
  • Dog Care - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Wide range of dog health and behaviour tips that will help you provide the best possible care for your canine companion.
  • Dog Health Center - FETCH by WebMD - Collection of information resources related to dog health.
  • Gastric Dilation-Volvulus (Bloat) - Veterinary Medical Center of Central New York - Discusses bloat in dogs, a deadly but preventable condition with its causes, signs, treatment, prognosis, prevention and care.
  • Heartworm Disease in Dogs: Testing - VCA Animal Hospitals - Information about the heartworm disease in dogs.
  • Parvo in Dogs and Puppies - Ellen Malmanger, DVM on PetMD - Exhaustive guide on Canine parvovirus (CPV) causes, symptoms, treatment and recovery.
  • Routine Health Care of Dogs, Pet Owner Version - MSD (Merck) Vet Manual - General dog care information for pet owners. If you have a puppy, see Puppy Care.

Dogs / Dog Behaviour & Training

  • Dunbar Academy's Dog Star Daily Blog - Dr. Ian Dunbar - Blogs and articles about dog behavior and things to know about training your puppy or dog.
  • Puppyhood Made Easy blog - The Puppy Academy - Blog posts about puppy training with topics ranging from potty training, safety to good manners.
  • Puppy Training - Americal Kennel Club - Collection of articles related to puppy training with topics like socializing, barn hunt, safe chewing and common puppy training challenges.
  • Peach on a Leash dog training blog - Blog covering dog training topics like teaching commands (like "drop it"), puppy biting, training with dog treats, identifying if your dog is a candidate for service dog work.
  • Susan Garrett's Dog Training Blog - Dog training blog posts on topics ranging from dog brain games, stress management to positive dog training, agility transformation and recall training.

Dogs / Dog Diet & Nutrition

  • Dog Nutrition: A Guide to Dog Nutrients - Tiffany Tupler, DVM, CBCC-KA on PetMD - Article with things to know about dog nutrition, including what to look for in a dog food.
  • Feeding your growing puppy - Royal Kennel Club - Guide with a host of tips and hints to help decide the right diet for your dog.
  • My Pet Nutritionist blog - Nutrition blog for dogs and cats on topics like allergies, dietary needs, disease management, gut health and general health.
  • Nutrition 101: Choosing the right diet for your dog - Chimacum Valley Veterinary Hospital - Quick tips to help in choosing the right diet for your dog.
  • Nutrition Guide - Pooch & Mutt - Searchable nutrition guide from dog experts.
  • What should I feed my puppy? - Blue Cross UK - Comprehensive article covering when, how often and where to feed the puppy, (mind) activity feeding and dog weight assessment.
  • What can I feed my dog when I’ve run out of dog food? - Animal Friends UK - Article provides some safe alternatives to dog food that you might find in your fridge or cupboards, to fall back on in case dog food at home is over.
  • Your dog's diet - The People's Dispensary for Sick Animals (PDSA) - Article covers what and how much to feed your dog along with changing dog food and selecting healthy treats for your dog.

Fishes / Fish Care & Treatment

  • AqAdvisor - Intelligent Freshwater Aquarium Stocking Calculator to help setup correct stocks and filters for your aquariums and tropical fish.
  • Aquarium Care and Maintenance: Nutrition and Feeding - FDACS - Comprehensive information guide about fish care, maintenance, aquarium components and water quality.
  • Caring for Fish & Aquariums - The Spruce Pets - Comprehensive collection of vet-reviewed articles on fishes and aquariums.
  • Keeping Fish at Home: Fish Nutrition - UK Pet Food - Concise and illustrative article on fish nutrition and how to choose the right diet for your fish.
  • FishLore - Provides aquarium fish information for both freshwater and saltwater hobbyists.
  • Fishkeeper Databank - Searchable database of information about fishes, fish food, filters etc.
  • Education Center - LiveAquaria - Aquarium care related information for various fish species.
  • Seriously Fish - Searchable database of fish species information, also includes a fish care blog.

Fishes / Fish Behaviour & Training

  • Enrichment and Training for Aquarium Fish - IAABC Foundation Journal
  • Fish Feeding Guides - Fishkeeper - Guides with details of what to feed and the amounts to feed/feeding frequency.
  • Fish Training (White Sturgeon) Podcast & Video - Johnny May - Target training a white sturgeon, with emphasis on application of positive reinforcement.
  • How to Train a Fish (with Videos) - Aquatic Veterinary Services - Target training of fishes with sounds & lights.
  • Target Training a Betta Fish - Finley B. Fish blog - A concise blog post about target training a Betta fish.
  • Training Fish and Aquatic Invertebrates for Husbandry and Medical Behaviors - Allison L. Corwin - Comprehensive guide on fish caretaking and training, available as a free PDF.

Fishes / Fish Diet & Nutrition

  • Understanding Aquarium Fish Nutrition - LiveAquaria - Information about dietary needs, concerns, balanced diet and different foods for complete nutrition.

Horses / Horse Care & Treatment

  • Horse care: health tips from foals to senior years - Boehringer Ingelheim - Comprehensive collection of articles, stories and insights on all aspects of horse health.
  • Horse Care - American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (ASPCA) - Quick list of horse care tips including nutritional needs, vaccination, deworming, etc.
  • Horse health, care and management - British Horse Society - Collection of articles and blog posts related to horse-health on aspects like health & fitness, routine health care, stabling & pasture information and care of elderly horses.

Horses / Horse Behaviour & Training
